<!-- Generated by codeflower-app's cmd/gendocs: do not edit. -->

The tunnel serves the small bootstrap code that browsers run before they reach this computer. A compromised tunnel could serve other code there. This command downloads it and compares it with the hashes built into this code flower.


## Usage

```sh
codeflower tunnel verify
```

## Inherited flags

| Flag | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--config string` |  | config directory with config.yaml (or set $CODEFLOWER_CONFIG; default ~/.codeflower) |
